title: (No AI) Muse has a voice mode now
author: Jay Peters
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/STKB394_MUSE_AI_CVIRGINIA_D.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Meta now lets you have voice conversations with your Muse AI agent in real time, CEO Mark Zuckerberg [announced today](https://www.threads.com/@zuck/post/DfXrs6RGonx).

The feature has been rolled out to me, and I gave it a spin on the iOS app while writing this article. As you chat with your Muse agent, the avatar at the top of your conversation animates in time with the words that it's saying. You can also change the tone of the voice by just asking your agent about what you want and letting it decide or by browsing through a bunch of options in the avatar settings.

[](https://www.threads.com/@muse/post/DfXsBBYCnf5)

title: (No AI) Claude AI can plug directly into your bank account
author: Jess Weatherbed
content:
![Three phones showing previews of Personal Finance in Claude](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/Personal-Finance-in-Claude-hed.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Anthropic has a new pitch for managing your personal finances: let Claude do it instead, with a new Personal Finance feature that connects it to your bank and card accounts via the Plaid bank bridging platform. You can ask the chatbot "where did my money go this month," for example, and it'll create an overview with a breakdown of spending by category, including rent and utilities, shopping, and food. Claude can also answer broader questions around what bills are left before your next payday, if you can afford big purchases like holiday trips, and how much money you could be saving each month.
